name: Shaula Bernstein
original_name: シャウラ・バーンシュタイン
source:
Grade: Second Year
Affiliation: Fighting Game Study Group
Attributes: Half-Vampire Half-Succubus, childhood friend
Problems: Small breasts
Erogenous Zone(s): Boobs, Tail, Wings
Her father is of the prestigious Bernstein family of Vampires, and her mother is of the Asmodian family of demons. 
Her everyday personality is very bohemian. Although she is usually like this, there are many things that make her switch into her prevented Succubus personality.
She takes after her mother in almost every way... Except for "size".
Because Shunosuke has a lot of vitality and energy, she feeds off of him in the mornings.
